If you want a good and budget friendly hotel in Delhi. This is the best place to stay. It is a value for money hotel with amazing staff. I stayed here for four days and my experience was just amazing. The food is also good and location at the same time is perfect as it stands in the heart of CR Park.
The staff was also very polite and friendly which acted as icing on the cake.

My experience at the hotel was excellent. The rooms were clean and comfortable, and the staff was polite and helpful. All facilities were provided on time. The food was fresh and delicious, and the environment felt safe and peaceful.
I would definitely recommend this hotel to others and look forward to staying here again in the further.

Excellent service, satisfaction at this property. We stayed here for our daughter’s marriage function occupying 15 rooms for 4-5 days

Sh Ranjan Das, Sh Akshay, of Kastor Hotel provided all help to us for all functions.

Best wishes, Surya Banerji, CA LLB
